//: Example Meteor settings for a local run. Copy this file to settings.dev.json (git-ignored) and fill in only the keys for the features you use; an empty value leaves that feature off. Never commit a settings file with real values. Production and test read their settings from METEOR_SETTINGS (a Kubernetes Secret), and a self-hosted install writes its own .state/settings.json (see self-host/README.md).

slateboxAPI.//: The key pair the collaboration relay is given as API_KEYS ([{"name":"slatebox","publicKey":...,"secretKey":...}]); live editing between people needs it. self-host/init.mjs makes one. Left empty, editing and saving still work.

googleImageSearch.//: Picture search (Google Programmable Search). Server only: never move these into public.

nounProject.//: Icon search for custom shapes and the style bar (The Noun Project API key and secret, OAuth 1.0a). Leave both empty to turn icon search off: the custom shape pane then offers only drawing with AI.

mailGun.//: SMTP URL for login links, invitations and password resets, e.g. smtps://user:password@smtp.example.com:465

chatWoot.//: HMAC token Chatwoot uses to verify a signed-in user. The widget itself is configured under public.chatWoot.

googleDocs.//: OAuth client for Google Docs import (Google Cloud console, web application client).

stripe.//: Server only. apiBase overrides the Stripe API host (tests); apiVersion pins a dated Stripe API release (empty keeps the built-in one). businessPortalConfiguration: an optional customer portal configuration (bpc_...) for a team's Slatebox Business card and receipts.

business.//: Slatebox Business bought in the app for a team (server/business-billing.mjs). The ids of two recurring, per-unit, licensed Stripe prices the owner makes in Stripe: monthly and yearly, quantity = the team's members. The sheet shows the amount Stripe has for them. With either id empty, Business is not sold in the app and the team page says Talk to us.

metering.//: Slatebox Cloud's AI and call meter. Leave off for local development and self-hosting; see server/metering/README.md.

public.//: Everything under public reaches every browser. Only keys that are meant to be public belong here. edition: "self-host" (the default when missing) or "cloud" (Slatebox Cloud only, imports/api/common/edition.mjs; it unlocks nothing without Slatebox Cloud's own key in enterprise.license). The server adds public.enterprise itself at start (whether enterprise code is unlocked here); do not set it.

agents.//editDirectly: Lets the person who brought an agent (or the slate owner) let it save without suggestions, each change undoable. Off unless true.

stripe.//: In-app payments (Stripe Payment Element). Set the publishable key (pk_...) that pairs with stripePrivateKey; without one, payments use the hosted Stripe page. inApp: false turns the in-app sheet off. At startup the app checks the pair and sets inApp itself.

chatWoot.//: Chatwoot support widget. It loads only when websiteToken is set; enabled: false turns it off.

analytics.//: Google Analytics. The gtag config is served only when gaId (a G- measurement id) is set.

enterprise.//: Enterprise features (enterprise/: outside agent connections, invited agents and their integrations) run on Slatebox Cloud (with Cloud's own signed key, kind cloud) and on a self-hosted install once a license key from Slatebox LLC unlocks them (Upgrade on prem). Each key names the host names it covers (public.baseUrl), one install per on-prem license. license: the key itself; or licenseFile: a file holding it; or the SLATEBOX_LICENSE or SLATEBOX_LICENSE_FILE environment variables. Checked offline at start (server/enterprise-license.mjs). Single sign-on with the bundled Keycloak needs no license.

connectors.//off: The kill switch for invited agents wherever enterprise code runs: true takes "+ Invite agent" and every connectors call away. Leave false.
connectors.//: Enterprise (enterprise/). oauthApps: apps registered with a vendor ahead of time. The client id is public; the client secret comes from this file or the environment that fills it, never from code. The OAuth callback is <public.baseUrl>/connectors/oauth/callback. Sign-in to outside servers also needs the SLATEBOX_KEY_ENCRYPTION_KEY environment variable.
